text:
Ava - Marketing: quick sync — need final hero lines for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private by EOD fri. also tying webinar CTA to lead routing. can folks weigh in? :spiral_calendar:
Raja - Growth: got it. prioritise: 1) headline that clarifies deployment mode, 2) single CTA pattern for webinar vs trial, 3) routing rule for enterprise leads.
Marta - Product: for Dedicated landing the promise should be predictability + SLA. short headline idea: 'Reserved capacity. Predictable performance.'
Lucas - Design: +1 Marta. For Private page we should avoid 'cloud' imagery. use locked data/network metaphor.
Samira - Content: rough hero candidates — Hosted: 'Ship fast with our hosted API — low latency, instant onboarding.' Dedicated: "Reserved capacity. Consistent throughput." Private: "Control your inference: VPC & on‑prem options." Which tone? direct or benefit-led?
Ava - Marketing: prefer benefit-led but tight. we have 40–50 chars in hero. can we compress?
Samira - Content: compressed suggestions — Hosted: 'Hosted API — start in minutes.' Dedicated: 'Dedicated GPUs — steady throughput.' Private: 'Private deploys — keep data inside your network.'
Raja - Growth: for webinar CTA we want one pathway: 'See it in action' -> captures org size + infra questions. then route big orgs to AE, mid to nurture. propose rule: if "company_size > 200 OR requires_vpc == true" -> AE queue.
Marta - Product: can we capture that as a short form field? EventBot: New registration form created: https://forms.example.com/redwood-webinar-mar.
Lucas - Design: quick mock updates: I'll attach a 2-col hero where left is headline + CTA, right is capacity visual. keeps parity across three pages.
Samira - Content: microcopy for CTA variants — primary: 'Watch demo' secondary: 'Request trial' — use primary on all pages, secondary only on Hosted/Dedicated. Private page shows 'Contact sales' prominently.
Ava - Marketing: routing note: make sure marketing tags source=webinar, page=hosted|dedicated|private. growth can map funnel. Raja can you confirm Zapier mapping to SFDC?
Raja - Growth: yes — mapping draft: 
```
source: webinar
page: {{page_slug}}
company_size: {{company_size}}
requires_vpc: {{requires_vpc}}
```
if company_size >= 200 OR requires_vpc==true -> lead.owner = 'AE-team'; else -> 'SDR-nurture'.
Samira - Content: small copy ask — hero footline to call out cost/perf tradeoffs? maybe one-liner under hero: 'Optimize latency and cost with batching, caching, and smart routing.'
Marta - Product: love that. makes the value prop precise for engineers.
Lucas - Design: UX question — do we show benchmark snippets on hero or a secondary module?
Ava - Marketing: move short benchmark stat (e.g., '95ms p95 token latency on popular workloads') into the hero microcopy for Hosted, and into 'Performance' card for Dedicated/Private. keeps hero focused but credible.
Samira - Content: proposed final heroes (40 chars each): Hosted: 'Hosted API — production inference, zero ops.' Dedicated: 'Dedicated GPUs — guaranteed throughput.' Private: 'Private deployment — customer‑managed network.' microcopy under hero: 'Latency, cost, and reliability controls for production LLMs.'
Raja - Growth: happy with CTAs and routing. one more — capture 'model type' in form so we can recommend quantization/config later.
Ava - Marketing: timeline: copy freeze Thurs noon, designs by Thurs EOD, dev implements Friday. can we all hit that?
Marta - Product: confirmed.
Lucas - Design: confirmed. I'll push the Figma link in thread when ready.
Samira - Content: I'll run quick A/B: 'Watch demo' vs 'See pricing' — test on Hosted traffic first week.
EventBot: Reminder set for Thu 12:00 PM to 'Copy freeze — tri pages'.
Ava - Marketing: thanks team — this is actionable. share final snippets here and I'll collate into the CMS import. :rocket:
